title: Advanced SELECT [Aggregate Functions]
description:
## Aggregate Functions
You already know `COUNT(*)`. Here are the rest:

- `SUM(column)` - adds up all values
- `AVG(column)` - average of all values
- `MIN(column)` - smallest value
- `MAX(column)` - largest value

You can use them with or without GROUP BY:
```sql
-- total across everything
SELECT SUM(size) FROM buckets;

-- total per group
SELECT type, SUM(size) FROM buckets GROUP BY type;
```
